personality_one_liner: A bright, bouncy, and delicious match-3 experience that feels as warm and satisfying as a fresh Philly cheesesteak.

spacing.rule: Use playful, generous spacing to let chunky, touchable cards breathe. Avoid dense grouping. Every interactable element should feel like a physical block or pill.

do's: Use solid playful surfaces and rounded containers to maintain the tactile cartoon aesthetic.
dont's: Do not use blur overlays that wash out the bright colors.

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: Launchpad for the game, featuring a massive Play button, and access to Shop and Leaderboards.

states.loading: Bouncing soft pretzel icon in the center.
states.error: Failed to load profile. Retry button.

screens.layout: Full-bleed background image of a colorful diner with vertical gradient scrim (top to bottom fade to surfaceInverse). Massive primary 'Play' CTA in the lower third (thumb zone). A top bar indicating player coin balance. Floating secondary buttons for Shop and Leaderboard stacked above the Play button.

screens.name: LevelMap
screens.purpose: A scrolling progression path where players unlock iconic Philly dishes.

states.error: Failed to sync map progress. Retry button.

screens.layout: Vertical scrolling path with staggered level nodes. Background has subtle diner/skyline patterns. Unlocked levels use brandSecondary (Red) or brandPrimary (Yellow), locked levels use surfaceTertiary. Bottom sticky button to return Home.

screens.name: Gameplay
screens.purpose: The core match-3 experience where players swap ingredients to complete customer orders.
screens.layout: Top HUD: Moves left (oversized text), Score, Pause button. Center: 7x7 or 8x8 grid of rounded, chunky ingredient tiles on a surfaceSecondary board with borderStrong outline. Bottom: Order queue cards showing customer avatar and required ingredient counts, using horizontal scroll or side-by-side cards.

screens.name: CookingResult
screens.purpose: A celebratory popup when an order is completed, showing the final Philly dish and rewards.
screens.layout: Full-screen overlay modal with a dark translucent backdrop. Central chunky card displaying the cooked dish (e.g., Cheesesteak), celebratory text, coins earned, and a massive 'Continue' pill button.

screens.name: Shop
screens.purpose: Spend earned coins on kitchen upgrades and gameplay boosters.

states.empty: No items available to purchase right now.

screens.layout: Top bar with current coin balance. 2-column grid of upgrade cards. Each card has an illustration, title, and a coin-price button. Cards use surfaceSecondary with heavy lg radius.

screens.name: Leaderboard
screens.purpose: Global ranking of top chefs based on score or dishes served.

states.empty: No rankings yet. Be the first to cook!
states.error: Could not connect to leaderboard. Retry.

screens.layout: List rows of players. Top 3 highlighted with brandTertiary/brandPrimary tints. Each row has rank, initials avatar, name, and score. Sticky bottom bar showing the current user's rank.

screens.name: Profile
screens.purpose: Displays player stats and gameplay history.
screens.layout: Top section with large player avatar and username. Middle section: stats grid (Dishes Cooked, High Score, Current Level) using surfaceSecondary cards. Bottom: list of unlocked dishes.

instructions_to_main_agent: Follow 4 Tactile / Playful LIGHT personality rules strictly. This is a game UI - components should feel touchable, bouncy, and distinct.
Do not use default React Native navigation headers; build custom top HUDs that fit the game aesthetic.
Grid layout for Match-3 (Gameplay screen) must be prominent and use 'borderStrong' outlines to contain the grid cells.
For typography, use Fredoka for all headings, scores, and large buttons. Use Nunito for smaller labels and body text.
The Order Queue (Gameplay bottom area) should contain cards displaying a customer avatar + required ingredients. The ingredients should be clear icons with count badges.
In the Home screen, ensure the 'Play' button is massive, pill-shaped, and sticky in the bottom safe area.
Use a top-down gradient scrim (black/transparent) on any background images so foreground text remains readable.
Avoid glassmorphism. Use solid colors and shadow tier 2 to make UI pop.
Ensure all tappable elements have a minimum size of 44x44pt and utilize a press-scale animation (0.93) to feel responsive.
